about_the_game:
Litter Factory is a fast paced, cooperative simulation game where you and your friends become The Waste Warriors, an unstoppable team on a mission to clean up the world, one piece of trash at a time! Work together to collect, sort, and recycle waste into valuable resources, keeping your factory running and the planet shining.

But don’t get too comfortable, chaos is always around the corner. Orders are piling up, machines are breaking down, and the power grid can barely keep up. Will your team stay in sync, or will your factory fall into a pile of garbage?

Gameplay

In the Litter Factory game, teamwork and communication are your most powerful tools. You’ll receive a constant stream of recycling orders from trucks arriving at your facility. To complete them, you and your partner must:

  • Pick the correct trash items from the bins.

  • Sort and recycle them into the right machines.

  • Deliver the recycle result before the timer runs outs

Every correctly recycled item earns you points, but one wrong move like tossing plastic into the wrong machine , and boom you will have explosive consequences (literally). Your machine will break down and burn, forcing your team to grab water and cool them down.

Power and Chaos Management

Recycling isn’t just about sorting, it's about survival. Your factory runs on limited energy, and when you run out of electricity, you’ll need to refill power by pumping the electric generator. Manage your time wisely between recycling and refilling, or risk the whole operation shutting down mid game.

Every mistake costs you time, energy, and points, but quick thinking and teamwork can turn any disaster into a comeback moment.

If you and your friends are ready to clean up the world while keeping the factory running through all the chaos, it’s time to prove you’re the ultimate Waste Warriors.

See you in Litter Factory!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i3 gen 11 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: mx 330 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad Recommended

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
